StackPanel.TextBlock: FM: NAVAL INTELLIGENCE, NORTHWOOD TO: COMMANDER, TG NORTHWIND INFO: OPERATION STEADFAST LANTERN DTG: 181200Z APR 28 SUBJ: INTSUM 04/28 - SKAGERRAK ENGAGEMENT

1. (S) Three renegade units were destroyed in the Skagerrak box on 17 April. Assessed composition of the Nordverband is now four surface combatants, three Type 212A boats and the flagship. The force is finite and losses are not being made good.
2. (S) NORDVERBAND CONDUCT. The renegade group has fired on no neutral vessel in three weeks of blockade. Boarding parties have been correct to the point of formality. Assessment is that Konteradmiral Vahl is holding his people to alliance rules of engagement while refusing alliance orders, and that he understands exactly how difficult this makes him to fight.
3. (S) INTENTIONS. The group has moved south into the northern Kattegat and has detained a three-ship merchant convoy inside its barrier line. The convoy carries approximately 410 persons including passengers. It has not been harmed and it has not been released.
4. (S) Assessment: the convoy is not being held for ransom. Its detention appears intended to force a decision the alliance has so far declined to make.
5. (S) UNRESOLVED - FISHING VESSEL. A side trawler under Panamanian registry held station within the traffic separation scheme for the duration of the 17 April engagement, approximately three nautical miles outside the engagement area, and put no gear over the side at any point.
6. (S) The registered owner is a holding company incorporated eleven weeks ago. The vessel was not in the Skagerrak before 2 April. She has since been observed twice more, on both occasions within visual range of a Nordverband unit and on neither occasion fishing.
7. (S) Somebody is watching this operation who is not a party to it. Nothing further is assessed at this time. Request all units report sightings.
